    if (isLoading || newValue === '') {
        return;
    }

    var selectedMode = (newValue || '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();

    // 1. UPI Flow: Display QR code immediately via modal
    if (selectedMode === 'upi') {
        var sysId = g_form.getUniqueValue();
        var dummyURL = 'https://example.com/ticket?id=' + sysId;
        var qrImageUrl = 'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=250x250&data=' + encodeURIComponent(dummyURL);

        spModal.open({
            title: "Scan & Pay via UPI",
            widget: "metro_qr_widget",
            widgetInput: { qr_url: qrImageUrl },
            buttons: [
                { label: 'Cancel', cancel: true },
                { label: 'I Have Paid', primary: true }
            ]
        }).then(function() {
            // Remind the user to upload their proof before ordering
            spModal.alert("Payment received! Please attach your transaction screenshot using the paperclip icon (top right), then click Order Now.");
        }).catch(function() {
            // If the user closed or cancelled the modal without paying
            g_form.clearValue('mode_of_payment');
        });
    } 
    // 2. Card or Others Flow: Remind to attach receipt
    else if (selectedMode === 'card' || selectedMode === 'others' || selectedMode.indexOf('card') !== -1 || selectedMode.indexOf('other') !== -1) {
        spModal.alert("Please make sure to attach your payment receipt using the paperclip icon before clicking Order Now.");
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-08 16:13:43</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>dc9a76c883574f10fb185e65eeaad36d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Qr generation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_dc9a76c883574f10fb185e65eeaad36d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-12 14:57:29</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    var sourceId = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destId = g_form.getValue('going_to');
    var numPassengers = Number(newValue) || 0;
    var journeyType = (g_form.getValue('type_of_journey') || '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();

    if (!sourceId || !destId || numPassengers <= 0 || sourceId == destId) {
        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        return;
    }

    // Map sys_ids to readable short keys
    var sysIdMap = {
        '28cf55c4835b0f10fb185e65eeaad37c': 'ameerpet',
        '56df5948835b0f10fb185e65eeaad3c5': 'madhapur',
        '02ef15cc835b0f10fb185e65eeaad3d9': 'lbnagar',
        'c04f9d4c835b0f10fb185e65eeaad3dc': 'kukatpally',
        'cbaf5100835b0f10fb185e65eeaad335': 'jubileehills',
        'cebf9d8c835b0f10fb185e65eeaad387': 'panjagutta',
        '07cf5944831b0f10fb185e65eeaad316': 'uppal'
    };

    var srcKey = sysIdMap[sourceId];
    var dstKey = sysIdMap[destId];

    // Explicit Fare matrix for every single combination (Single Journey in ₹)
    var fareMatrix = {
        'ameerpet': {
            'panjagutta': 15, 'jubileehills': 20, 'madhapur': 30,
            'kukatpally': 30, 'uppal': 45, 'lbnagar': 50
        },
        'panjagutta': {
            'ameerpet': 15, 'jubileehills': 25, 'madhapur': 35,
            'kukatpally': 35, 'uppal': 45, 'lbnagar': 45
        },
        'jubileehills': {
            'ameerpet': 20, 'panjagutta': 25, 'madhapur': 20,
            'kukatpally': 35, 'uppal': 55, 'lbnagar': 55
        },
        'madhapur': {
            'ameerpet': 30, 'panjagutta': 35, 'jubileehills': 20,
            'kukatpally': 35, 'uppal': 60, 'lbnagar': 60
        },
        'kukatpally': {
            'ameerpet': 30, 'panjagutta': 35, 'jubileehills': 35,
            'madhapur': 35, 'uppal': 60, 'lbnagar': 60
        },
        'uppal': {
            'ameerpet': 45, 'panjagutta': 45, 'jubileehills': 55,
            'madhapur': 60, 'kukatpally': 60, 'lbnagar': 50
        },
        'lbnagar': {
            'ameerpet': 50, 'panjagutta': 45, 'jubileehills': 55,
            'madhapur': 60, 'kukatpally': 60, 'uppal': 50
        }
    };

    var price = 0;
    if (srcKey && dstKey && fareMatrix[srcKey] && fareMatrix[srcKey][dstKey]) {
        price = fareMatrix[srcKey][dstKey];
    } else {
        // Fallback standard fare if any sys_id wasn't matched
        price = 35;
    }

    var isSingle = (journeyType == '1' || journeyType.indexOf('single') !== -1);

    if (isSingle) {
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        g_form.setValue('amount_for_single_journey', (numPassengers * price).toString());
    } else {
        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.setValue('amount_including_return', (numPassengers * price * 2).toString());
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-08 16:07:50</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e0697a0883574f10fb185e65eeaad34f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>13</sys_mod_count><sys_name>auto calculation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_e0697a0883574f10fb185e65eeaad34f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-09 02:33:38</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
